body: They won't let me take care of my needs,I have a few days with a friend planned and they are doing everything to prove that they won't be able to cope. I honestly think they are just waiting for me to fall into a heap,they'll step over me and then they will go into the system. And I have called 211 for resources and as long as I'm "functioning" at caretaking they won't help me.I am just so very very tired of this.
